name: weekly-leadership-rollup
description: Builds a cross-team weekly status rollup a leader can read in two minutes: for each tracker team you can see (up to 8), what shipped in the last 7 days, what is in flight, what is blocked and what is due next week, plus launch, review and release events from your calendar. It then runs a reality check: where the status people reported in status-like chat channels (or in an update you paste) disagrees with the tickets (reported done but still in review, on track but blocked or not updated for weeks), each item quoted with its link and framed as a question to ask, not a conclusion. Read-only: it never posts, sends or changes anything (copy the rollup yourself), never reads direct messages, and never ranks teams or people. Refuses rather than guessing when the tracker is not connected.

skills.name: Weekly leadership rollup
skills.description: Per-team shipped / in flight / blocked / next week from the tracker and calendar for the last 7 days (3 to 14), and a reality check of chat-reported status against the tickets (rules D1 to D11, risk high/medium/low), with quotes and links. Read-only, copy-only; no ranking.
examples: Where does the reported status differ from the tickets for Payments?
Rollup since Monday for platform and payments
